\newpage

Directional movement is calculated as the pre-treatment position minus the post-treatment position. This is based on the coordinate system with the y axis running approximately along the midline and the x axis sitting somewhere around the tooth 2/tooth 14 position (shown in the image above). Using this reference system and directional movement calculated as pre minus post, interpretation of the sign of directional movement is challenging: expansion in the x direction for tooth 2 is denoted by a positive number but expansion for tooth 14 is denoted by a positive number. 

This interpretation issue is purely driven by the location of the arch in the coordinate system. The next time we do this, I want to move the arches entirely into the (+,+) quadrant as I believe that will alleviate the issue entirely as well as not cause any other issues

Note: these scans are automatically aligned to an ideally aligned "master arch". The "master arch" is manually (to an extent) moved to a specific alignment. The automatic alignment of the scans means they are not perfectly aligned like the "master arch" and this is what has created these interpretation issues for us. I believe that these issues would be completely eliminated by moving the master arch fully into the (+,+) quadrant.

medTab = (

  rename(
    columns = {
      "toothNum": "Tooth Number",

      "absMedZ": "Z Median (Abs. val.)",
      "medL2": "Length Median (L2 norm)"
    }
  ).
  style.

  ).

```{python}

#row bind all of the diff data for the different teeth
flatter = {}
for i in res["mainResults"].keys():
  aaa = res["mainResults"][i]["diffDat"]
  aaa["toothNum"] = i
  flatter[i] = aaa
fullDiffDat = pd.concat(flatter, axis = 0, ignore_index=True)
#manipulating the data
fullDiffDat["toothNum"] = pd.to_numeric(fullDiffDat["toothNum"])

#median table with absolute values
medDf = res["medianTable"]
medDf["toothNum"] = pd.to_numeric(medDf["toothNum"])

#plots for each direcional movement
absPlotX = (
  ggplot(fullDiffDat, aes(x = "toothNum", y = "x", color = "toothNum")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray") +
  geom_jitter(alpha = .5, height = 0, width = .3) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = range(
      np.min(fullDiffDat["toothNum"]),
      np.max(fullDiffDat["toothNum"]) + 1,
      1
    )
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend_position="none") +
  labs(
    title = "Movement in X, " + patNum,
    y = "X",
    x = "Tooth Number",
    subtitle = "Medians plotted"
  ) +
  geom_point(data = medDf, mapping = aes(x = "toothNum", y = "medX"), color = "red") 
)
absPlotY = (
  ggplot(fullDiffDat, aes(x = "toothNum", y = "y", color = "toothNum")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray") +
  geom_jitter(alpha = .5, height = 0, width = .3) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = range(
      np.min(fullDiffDat["toothNum"]),
      np.max(fullDiffDat["toothNum"]) + 1,
      1
    )
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend_position="none") +
  labs(
    title = "Movement in Y, " + patNum,
    y = "Y",
    x = "Tooth Number",
    subtitle = "Medians plotted"
  ) +
  geom_point(data = medDf, mapping = aes(x = "toothNum", y = "medY"), color = "red")
)
absPlotZ = (
  ggplot(fullDiffDat, aes(x = "toothNum", y = "z", color = "toothNum")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray") +
  geom_jitter(alpha = .5, height = 0, width = .3) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = range(
      np.min(fullDiffDat["toothNum"]),
      np.max(fullDiffDat["toothNum"]) + 1,
      1
    )
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend_position="none") +
  labs(
    title = "Movement in Z, " + patNum,
    y = "Z",
    x = "Tooth Number",
    subtitle = "Median plotted"
  ) +
  geom_point(data = medDf, mapping = aes(x = "toothNum", y = "medZ"), color = "red")
)
plotL2 = (
  ggplot(fullDiffDat, aes(x = "toothNum", y = "l2Norm", color = "toothNum")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray") +
  geom_jitter(alpha = .5, height = 0, width = .3) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = range(
      np.min(fullDiffDat["toothNum"]),
      np.max(fullDiffDat["toothNum"]) + 1,
      1
    )
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend_position="none") +
  labs(
    title = "L2 norm of movement vector, " + patNum,
    y = "L2 Norm",
    x = "Tooth Number",
    subtitle = "Median plotted"
  ) +
  geom_point(data = medDf, mapping = aes(x = "toothNum", y = "medL2"), color = "red")
)
display(absPlotX)
display(absPlotY)
display(absPlotZ)
display(plotL2)
```
